WorkspaceData.title: Data
WorkspaceData.subtitle: Bring existing relationship history into this workspace without triggering automation or alert noise.

WorkspaceMembers.subtitle: People with access to {workspace}.
WorkspaceMembers.inviteAccessSubtitle: Add teammates by email, share a join link, or auto-approve trusted email domains.
WorkspaceMembers.inviteSubtitle: Send an invite link. They join after signing in with the invited email.
WorkspaceMembers.memberInvited: Invitation sent — they'll see it in their notifications.
WorkspaceMembers.linkSubtitle: Anyone with the link can join with the role you choose. No email required.

WorkspaceRoles.title: Roles
WorkspaceRoles.subtitle: Define custom roles with exactly the permissions a teammate needs.
WorkspaceRoles.noAccess: Only workspace owners can manage roles.
WorkspaceRoles.builtInSubtitle: Standard access levels. These can't be edited.
WorkspaceRoles.createDescription: Pick a name and the exact actions this role can take.
WorkspaceRoles.noPermissionsHint: Select at least the actions this role should allow.

WorkspaceRules.title: Rules & automation
WorkspaceRules.subtitle: Run actions automatically when records change or on a schedule.
WorkspaceRules.emptyBody: Create a rule to automate follow-up tasks, tags, and notifications.
WorkspaceRules.noAccess: Only members with rule access can manage automation.
WorkspaceRules.createDescription: Choose what triggers the rule and what it does.
WorkspaceRules.ruleNamePlaceholder: e.g. Follow up on won deals
WorkspaceRules.systemRunAsRestricted: Choose Me to save this rule. Only workspace owners and admins can run rules as Automation.
WorkspaceRules.systemToggleRestricted: Only workspace owners and admins can enable or disable Automation rules.
WorkspaceRules.conditionRequired: A scheduled rule needs at least one condition
WorkspaceRules.actionTitleRequired: Add a title for each action
WorkspaceRules.actionTagRequired: Choose a tag for the tag action

WorkspaceWorkflows.title: Workflows
WorkspaceWorkflows.subtitle: Automate repeatable work: pick a trigger, narrow it with conditions, and chain the actions Connex should take. Workflows run with full permission and audit guarantees.
WorkspaceWorkflows.emptyBody: Build your first workflow to create tasks, send notifications, or update records automatically when something happens.
WorkspaceWorkflows.duplicateSystemRestricted: Only workspace owners and admins can duplicate Automation workflows.
WorkspaceWorkflows.triggerHint: What starts this workflow, and who it runs as.
WorkspaceWorkflows.notFound: This workflow doesn't exist or was deleted.

dialog.requiredHint: Must be filled before a record can be saved.
dialog.classificationHint: Flag fields that hold sensitive personal information.

WorkspaceEmail.title: Email
WorkspaceEmail.subtitle: Send this workspace's invites from your own SMTP server. Without a custom server, mail uses the instance default.
WorkspaceEmail.enableDescription: When off, this workspace sends through the instance default sender.
WorkspaceEmail.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the stored password. Stored encrypted; never shown.
WorkspaceEmail.saveFailed: Your change couldn't be saved. Try again.
WorkspaceEmail.testSent: Test email sent. Check your inbox.
WorkspaceEmail.testFailed: The test email couldn't be sent.
WorkspaceEmail.loadFailed: Your email settings couldn't be loaded.

WorkspaceDelivery.title: Delivery
WorkspaceDelivery.subtitle: Choose how this workspace delivers campaign email. Use the workspace SMTP server, or route through a dedicated email service provider.
WorkspaceDelivery.enableDescription: When off, campaigns on this channel are held rather than delivered.
WorkspaceDelivery.smtpNote: Delivery uses this workspace's email settings. No extra configuration is needed.
WorkspaceDelivery.apiKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the stored key. Stored encrypted; never shown.
WorkspaceDelivery.webhookDescription: Your ESP posts delivery, bounce, and complaint events to this URL. Add the URL and secret to your ESP after generating them.
WorkspaceDelivery.webhookSaveFirst: Save the HTTP ESP provider before generating a webhook token.
WorkspaceDelivery.revealTitle: Store these now — you won't see them again
WorkspaceDelivery.revealWarning: This token and secret are shown only once and can't be recovered. Copy them into your ESP now; generate a new one if you lose them.
WorkspaceDelivery.tokenFailed: The webhook token couldn't be generated.
WorkspaceDelivery.saveFailed: Your change couldn't be saved. Try again.
WorkspaceDelivery.loadFailed: Your delivery settings couldn't be loaded.
WorkspaceDelivery.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to delivery settings
WorkspaceDelivery.forbiddenBody: Ask a workspace administrator to grant you workspace settings access.
WorkspaceDelivery.smsSubtitle: Route campaign SMS through an HTTP SMS gateway. Messages are plain text and use the sender id below.
WorkspaceDelivery.smsEnableDescription: When off, SMS campaigns are held rather than delivered.
WorkspaceDelivery.smsSenderIdHint: Shown as the sender on the recipient's handset. Letters, digits, spaces, and + . _ - only.
WorkspaceDelivery.connectorsSubtitle: Push frozen campaign audiences to an external list. Configure the HTTP list connector for this workspace.
WorkspaceDelivery.connectorsEnableDescription: When off, campaign audience exports to this connector are unavailable.

WorkspaceSso.title: Single sign-on
WorkspaceSso.subtitle: Let this organization's members sign in through your identity provider. Connex supports OpenID Connect and SAML 2.0.
WorkspaceSso.enableDescription: Turn on IdP login for members whose email domain is routed here.
WorkspaceSso.enforceDescription: Block password and passkey sign-in for this organization's members — they must use the IdP.
WorkspaceSso.jitWorkspaceHint: New members are added to this workspace on first sign-in.
WorkspaceSso.oidcIssuerHint: The IdP's OpenID discovery URL. Connex reads its endpoints automatically.
WorkspaceSso.oidcClientSecretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current secret.
WorkspaceSso.samlMetadataHint: Paste the IdP metadata, or provide the entity ID, sign-on URL, and certificate below.
WorkspaceSso.samlSpCertHint: Give this certificate to your IdP so it can verify Connex's signed requests. Generated automatically when you save.
WorkspaceSso.domainsHint: One domain per line. Members with these email domains are routed to this IdP.
WorkspaceSso.saveFailed: Your single sign-on settings couldn't be saved.
WorkspaceSso.loadFailed: Your single sign-on settings couldn't be loaded.
WorkspaceSso.noAccess: You need the Manage SSO permission to view this.
